descripcion: Atlético Mineiro and Boca Juniors meet in Barranquilla for the 2026 Copa Sudamericana final. Boca are chasing their third title in the competition and their first major international trophy since 2008, while Atlético Mineiro arrive after a strong knockout run of their own. With the trophy decided in a single match at the Estadio Metropolitano Roberto Meléndez, this is one of the biggest South American club fixtures of the season.

estadio: Campos de Sport de El Sardinero
